body.name: Observable centered oracle-adaptation Gram tests
body.construction:
For each \(x\), let \(a_x^{\mathrm{or}}\) minimize \(\ell_{\mathrm{PT}}(a)^{\prime}\Omega_x\ell_{\mathrm{PT}}(a)\) and let \(d_x^{\mathrm{or}}\) minimize \(\ell_{\mathrm{SC}}(d)^{\prime}\Omega_x\ell_{\mathrm{SC}}(d)\), using the Euclidean minimum-norm minimizer. Here \(\Omega_x\) is the Gram matrix of the centered basis in \(\mathrm{def{:}union\text{-}qp}\). Define the simultaneous discrepancy as
\[
 \sum_xp_X(x)c(a_x^{\mathrm{or}},d_x^{\mathrm{or}})^{\prime}\Omega_xc(a_x^{\mathrm{or}},d_x^{\mathrm{or}}),
\]
the PT-oracle discrepancy as
\[
 \min_{(d_x)}\sum_xp_X(x)c(a_x^{\mathrm{or}},d_x)^{\prime}\Omega_xc(a_x^{\mathrm{or}},d_x),
\]
and the SC-oracle discrepancy as
\[
 \min_{(a_x)}\sum_xp_X(x)c(a_x,d_x^{\mathrm{or}})^{\prime}\Omega_xc(a_x,d_x^{\mathrm{or}}).
\]
